title: Probation Policy 2022
text: Probation Policy 2022. The probation period for new hires is 3 months. Managers may extend it once.

title: Probation Policy 2024
text: Probation Policy 2024. The probation period for new hires is 6 months. Probation reviews happen at month 3 and month 6.

title: Notice Period Policy
text: Notice Period Policy. Employees must give 30 days notice when they resign.

title: Referral Bonus Policy
text: Referral Bonus Policy. The referral bonus is 500 USD, paid after the referred hire completes the first quarter.

title: Leave Policy
text: Leave Policy. Full time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per year.

title: Salary Bands (confidential)
text: Salary Bands. The grade 5 salary band is 52000 to 61000 USD per year.
